bg: A wide 16:9 view of a small snowy mountain station platform: deep snow on the roofs, a wooden station building, a little kiosk with snow globes and newspapers on the left, a blue vintage train with open doors on the right, pine trees, falling snow, early morning light.

chars.desc: an older woman kiosk owner named Mrs. Aalto, Finnish, pale skin, rosy cheeks, white hair in a bun under a knitted hat, a thick red coat, fingerless gloves
a young adult woman baggage helper named Tess, Irish, pale skin, freckles, red hair in a short ponytail, green work overalls, a cap, a clipboard
an adult man named Mr. Lindgren, Swedish, pale skin, light brown hair, a beard, a thick grey wool sweater, dark boots with snow on them
an adult woman named Ms. Quist, Dutch, pale skin, blonde hair in a bun, a long blue coat, a folded newspaper under her arm
an 8 year old girl named Mila, Polish, light skin, two blonde pigtails, a pink winter jacket, a woolly hat with a pom-pom

icons.name: snowglobe
icons.desc: a snow globe with a little mountain station inside
